verdict.rationale: No first-party acceptable-use or anti-abuse policy appears in the pack. The stealth (docs-4, docs-20) and CAPTCHA (docs-5) docs describe evasion capabilities with no usage restrictions. The only signal is a community report that Hyperbrowser added an 'ethical scraping' docs page (comm-9). The same commenters say users cannot follow robots.txt or limit request rates, and that the service ignores robots.txt (comm-8), so the posture looks thin and unenforced. Missing for 10: a vendor-published acceptable-use policy covering stealth and CAPTCHA use, documented anti-abuse enforcement or opt-out mechanisms (e.g. robots.txt honoring), and the ethical-scraping page content itself.
